about: Recorded by record_expectations.py --reformulations from the search as it was at recording time. reformulations.json holds two sets of up to four reformulations per question, written blind by agents that saw only the questions, never the wiki: the condition of a real reader agent. Every question runs once per set with its reformulations at --limit 12 and at --limit 100. merged_ranks names, per required page, its rank in results and its position in reformulation_results at limit 12 (results, block) and at limit 100 (results_100, block_100); null means absent. A page counts as found within N when its rank in results or its position in the block is at most N. floors are minimums, caps are maximums. tests/test_search_quality.py (ReformulationGate) fails when reformulations change the question's own results or coverage, when a set's merged found counts fall below its floors, when a required page leaves the merged top 3 or top 12 it held here unless accepted_regressions lists it (with set, id, path and a reason; accepted_rank holds it to that rank's bands), when the block of the seven negative questions grows beyond its cap, or when a navigation page enters the block. Caveats: the sets come from the same model family that is evaluated with them, so the numbers are optimistic; they are a regression gate and must never become a tuning target; a set is never edited to make the gate pass - a new set is added instead, and the commit explains why. Changing this file is a deliberate act: state the change and its reason in the commit message.
